title: Arknights 2.5 Anniversary Discord Event ----- Image Over Form
lines: Hello, Doctor. I suppose you are packed and ready for a new adventure in the land of Shangshu? Yeah, I know, new stories, adventures, friends, and rewards, bet you don't want to miss any of them. But before that, perhaps it might be worthwhile for you to take a peek at our Discord channel and learn more about Shangshu, a city depicted in paintings and poems. And of course, it is only natural for me to give no more than the basic instructions needed and leave the rest to your creative mind.
Duration
Recruitment Duration: July 28, 2022 - August 7, 2022
Event Duration: August 8, 2022 - August 14, 2022
Prizes
The Siblings’ Choice: Each member of the three teams (30 players in total) will receive an Arknights 2.5 Anniversary Character Plushie (randomly issued from Nian, Ling, and Dusk).
Lee’s Favor: Two teams (20 players in total) will be randomly selected and each of the team members will receive a $20 gift card.
How to participate
Please join our official Discord Channel at https://discord.gg/arknights first if you haven’t yet.

(Since this event will be held on our Discord channel, Doctors will have to become its members first to participate in the event. We also recommend verifying your identity for your Discord account in advance as it is required by Discord for sending messages on the channel)

Doctors are required to assemble a team of 10 players and play a full game of 10 rounds on https://garticphone.com/ in standard mode . The entry for each round of the game should be relevant to Arknights or its elements to be validated during the submission phase. Valid entries include but are not limited to Operators, Enemies, or even those Non-playable Characters in the game.
“Doctor.” Amiya whispers, “ Miss Ling was saying something like both she and her sisters would like to see something Yanese . Will it have something to do with their Choices?”
Team and Recruitment
Players can register a team or join a registered team to participate in the event.

- How to register a team: Use the /group create command in @Shaw DMs or in #bot-spam to fill out the form for team registration which will ask for your team name as well as whenever the team should be private or not, private teams can only be joined with an invite . Once your registration is complete, you will receive a team ID . Please keep this ID as it will be essential for players to join your team.

- How to join a team : Use the /group join ID command in @Shaw DMs or in #bot-spam along with the team ID to join an existing team. Please note each player is limited to registering or joining one team only. In order to join a private group, you need to ask the group leader to invite you prior to joining.

- How to invite a player to a team: Use the /group invite @user command in @Shaw DMs or in #bot-spam along with the tag or ID of the player you want to invite to the private group. Please note that this command is only available to private groups and only to the group leader.
- How to recruit team members : Players can post their recruitment info in #team-recruitment and promote their team in #event-discussion .
Submission Guidelines
Download the GIF after finishing the game and use the /submit command to send @Shaw a private message. She will guide you step by step to complete your submission.

All participants in the game must be members of the registered team and their in-game name must match the Discord name ( Username#1234 ). If we find that there are any unregistered substitutes or participants who do not use their Discord ID to play, the submission will be invalidated.
Each game will require 10 players and will be played in standard mode. Any team that violates the rule will have their submissions invalidated.
Only the leader of each team is entitled to submit their entry, with a total of three submissions allowed for each team.
Any valid submission should contain a sentence related to Arknights with at least one word provided by us for each round.
Submissions involving political, violent, pornographic, grotesque, or rule-breaking content will be invalidated. Commercial content is also prohibited.
Rules

Arknights EN will keep a record of all the successful submissions. Please contact us via arknights.event@yo-star.com or official customer service if you have any questions or problems regarding the results of the game.
Players can report any entry that violates the rules to an Admin or Yostar customer service staff.

Winning teams will be announced via #server-news within 5 working days after the event. The exact reward distribution time and method will be informed by our official customer service staff via Discord DM. Please enable the DM on Discord to ensure that you will not miss the notification.
Please take care of your private information. ArknightsEN is not responsible for any loss caused by mishandled private information.
Please note that each participant is limited to one award per event, and only the prize of the highest worth will be awarded if a participant wins multiple prizes
ArknightsEN reserves the final explanation of the event.
